strengths: Payment sequence (sumimasen → bill → exact change → leave) matches everyday restaurant life.
Loyalty, reviews, and return visits as gratitude channels feel locally accurate.
How Japanese People Talk About Good Service avoids invented first-person memoir while sounding true.
